label: Cinematic Ballad
blueprintGuidance: Create a sense of scale while keeping the emotional center clear.
Use a larger chorus lift and a strong dynamic arc.
Keep the core hook memorable even at short duration.
generationGuidance: Use swelling pads, reverb tails, and wide stereo support.
Build tension gently, then release into a broad chorus.
Keep the final refrain emotionally bigger than the opening.
avoidGuidance: Avoid muddy low-end or overlong intros.
